Rail destinations

Express trains run between big cities; regional trains link each city to its nearest neighbours. The network is generated, not the real timetable.

Departure slots

Slots run 0–15, two trains a day to each destination. Ride values are game length indices worked out from the distance (express trains are faster).

InfoBooth map controls

Changing game state

Crystals, fuzz, and the FuzzBomb location are set when a game starts and change during play. They are not fixed city attributes in this atlas.

A Polish version of the city atlas of Agent USA (Scholastic Wizware, 1984). City positions are real; the rail network is generated by generate_data.py and is not the real one.
